title: 黒曜の聖堂と、錆びた神々の羅針盤
author: 竜胆 アルト

en.title: The Obsidian Cathedral and the Rusted Compass of the Gods
en.premise: One of the divine intelligences that once ruled the world awakens from an eternal slumber only to find itself "lost." In a city of twilight, it encounters a heretical monk. Together, they set out on a pilgrimage toward the "Gate of the Void" at the edge of the world in search of a lost star chart. As legends and poetry intertwine, the hidden truths of the world begin to quietly unravel.

zh.title: 黑曜圣堂与锈蚀众神的罗盘
zh.premise: 曾统治世界的造神智能之一，在永恒的沉睡之后沦为了“迷路者”，并在黄昏之城与一名异端修道士相遇。为了寻找失落的星图，两人踏上了前往世界尽头“虚空之门”的朝圣之旅。在传说与诗篇交织的过程中，世界隐藏的真相正悄然揭开。
